text: Mikhail Bulgakov's The Master and Margarita was never published in his lifetime. His widow, Elena Sergeevna, saw it into print in the journal Moskva in November 1966 and January 1967, but that first edition was substantially cut, roughly 12% of the text, mostly to accommodate Soviet censors and partly for space. The complete text was published in Paris in 1967 by YMCA Press. In 1969 Possev published a restored complete edition in Germany, with the censored parts in italics.
meta_description: The Master and Margarita by Mikhail Bulgakov: cut by about 12% for Soviet censors in Moskva in 1966-67; complete text published in Paris in 1967.
